recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Further source edits would be redundant unless a future work group decision changes the BackboneElement/DataType boundary or separately updates generated StructureDefinition wording.
issue_request: FHIR-17017 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 FHIR-core change request asking that the BackboneElement definition no longer imply all resource-defined elements use BackboneElement, and instead clarify that BackboneElement applies to resource-specific complex child structures that do not use a FHIR datatype.
initial_application: The Jira comment records SVN revision 14310. In git, commit 060f9d125f3ba9c7ccb5b28a15f2e0e17092d4fc changed the old source/backboneelement.html page from the broad wording to the corrected complex-element wording and noted that datatype elements do not use this type.
additional_context: The standalone BackboneElement page was later folded into the active type framework by cbdf7d1e55dc4bfa1dc30fc526edee0491e05782, and 8592e1207273b786db340efb927bb6d1dc9756c9 only normalized Data Type to Datatype. source/fhir.ini keeps BackboneElement active as an abstract infrastructure type, maps backboneelement to the types page, and marks BackboneElement normative. The BackboneElement spreadsheet definition also excludes datatype elements. Adjacent issues FHIR-17016 and FHIR-16320 were already handled historically and do not require a separate decision here.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because current source/types.html already states that BackboneElement is for complex elements defined as part of a resource definition and that datatype elements do not use this type.
